body.name: Guarded empirical-cell contribution plug-in
body.construction: On the enlarged \(126\)-cell absorbing support, evaluate the entries of \(\mathfrak m(\widehat p)\) sequentially, stopping before an inverse or division whose required margin is at most \(\kappa\); also require legal absorbing support and \(\widehat\Sigma_{\ell\ell}>\kappa\) for every \(\ell\in\mathcal L\).  This event is \(\mathcal E_{\kappa}\).  On \(\mathcal E_{\kappa}\), set \(\widehat\theta=\Phi(\widehat p)\), \(\widehat G_i=J_{\Phi}(\widehat p)(e_{O_i}-\widehat p)\), and \(\widehat\Sigma=n^{-1}\sum_i\widehat G_i\widehat G_i^\top\); otherwise report that the sample is outside the regular recovery domain and return no interval.
